transcript: ˌpɪk ɛs ˌdʒiː ɛm ˈpiː ɡaɪd
definitions: A comprehensive set of guidelines for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) developed by the Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme (PIC/S).
An internationally recognized standard for quality assurance in the manufacturing of medicinal products.
examples: Compliance with the PIC/S GMP Guide is essential.
Many countries adopt the PIC/S GMP Guide.
The audit referenced the PIC/S GMP Guide.
